supplementalSource.scope: timelock balance and deposit endpoints; supplements the captured documentation

invariants.integerPrecision: Every JSON integer is returned as a canonical decimal string; fractional and exponent numbers remain JavaScript numbers.
invariants.retry: Only idempotent reads retry; official write and sensitive methods are forced to one attempt.
invariants.isolation: API and read RPC are standalone exports. Node administration and wallet RPC require trustedServer=true in a non-browser runtime.
invariants.fallback: No implicit REST-to-RPC or RPC-to-REST fallback.
